q: "If you touch fire, you get burned." Kalimat ini termasuk conditional tipe apa?
explain: Kedua klausa pakai present simple (touch, get burned) dan menyatakan fakta yang selalu benar — ini pola Zero Conditional, dipakai untuk kebenaran umum/hukum alam.

q: "If she studies hard, she will pass the exam." Kalimat ini termasuk conditional tipe apa?
explain: If-clause pakai present simple (studies) dan main clause pakai will + V1 (will pass) — pola First Conditional, untuk kondisi nyata dan mungkin terjadi di masa depan.

q: "If I were rich, I would buy a mansion." Kalimat ini termasuk conditional tipe apa?
explain: If-clause pakai past simple dengan "were" untuk subjek "I" (ciri khas Tipe 2), main clause pakai would + V1 — pola Second Conditional, khayalan yang tidak nyata sekarang.

q: "If he had left earlier, he would have caught the train." Kalimat ini termasuk conditional tipe apa?
explain: If-clause pakai past perfect (had left) dan main clause pakai would have + V3 (would have caught) — pola Third Conditional, penyesalan tentang sesuatu yang sudah tidak bisa diubah di masa lalu.

q: "Ice melts if you heat it." Kalimat ini termasuk conditional tipe apa?
explain: Kedua klausa present simple dan menyatakan fakta ilmiah yang selalu benar — Zero Conditional. Perhatikan main clause ditulis duluan di sini, tapi tipenya tetap ditentukan dari tense, bukan urutan.

q: "If I had wings, I would fly." Kalimat ini termasuk conditional tipe apa?
explain: If-clause past simple (had), main clause would + V1 (would fly) — Second Conditional, khayalan yang bertentangan dengan kenyataan sekarang (kenyataannya manusia tidak punya sayap).

q: "If they had practiced more, they would have won." Kalimat ini termasuk conditional tipe apa?
explain: If-clause past perfect (had practiced), main clause would have + V3 (would have won) — Third Conditional, membayangkan hasil berbeda dari kejadian masa lalu yang sudah selesai.

q: "If you don't hurry, you will miss the bus." Kalimat ini termasuk conditional tipe apa?
explain: If-clause present simple negatif (don't hurry), main clause will + V1 (will miss) — First Conditional, peringatan tentang konsekuensi nyata di masa depan.

q: "Water boils if you heat it to 100°C." Kalimat ini termasuk conditional tipe apa?
explain: Fakta ilmiah, kedua klausa present simple — Zero Conditional.

q: "If I hadn't missed the bus, I wouldn't have been late." Kalimat ini termasuk conditional tipe apa?
explain: If-clause past perfect negatif (hadn't missed), main clause would have + V3 negatif (wouldn't have been) — Third Conditional, penyesalan atas kejadian masa lalu.

q: If she ___ (study) hard, she will pass the exam.
explain: Ini Tipe 1 (ditandai "will pass" di main clause) — if-clause harus present simple, dan karena subjeknya "she" (orang ketiga tunggal), butuh akhiran -es: "studies".

q: If I ___ (be) you, I would apologize.
explain: Ini pola "if I were you" khas Tipe 2 — bentuk to be di if-clause hipotetis selalu "were" untuk semua subjek, termasuk "I".

q: If it ___ (rain), the ground gets wet. (kebenaran umum)
explain: Main clause "gets wet" pakai present simple, menandakan Zero Conditional — if-clause juga harus present simple, dan subjek "it" butuh -s: "rains".

q: If they had known about the meeting, they ___ (help) prepare it.
explain: If-clause pakai past perfect ("had known") — ciri Tipe 3, jadi main clause harus "would have + V3": "would have helped".

q: If we ___ (leave) now, we will arrive on time.
explain: Main clause "will arrive" menandakan Tipe 1 — if-clause harus present simple: "leave" (subjek "we", tidak butuh -s).

q: If I had more time, I ___ (finish) the project.
explain: If-clause "had" adalah past simple (bukan past perfect "had had"), jadi ini Tipe 2 murni — main clause harus "would + V1": "would finish".

q: If you heat ice, it ___ (melt).
explain: Fakta ilmiah, Zero Conditional — kedua klausa present simple, subjek "it" butuh -s: "melts".

q: If she ___ (not study), she would fail.
explain: Main clause "would fail" menandakan Tipe 2 — if-clause harus past simple negatif: "didn't study".

q: If he had studied, he ___ (pass) the test.
explain: If-clause past perfect ("had studied") menandakan Tipe 3 — main clause harus "would have + V3": "would have passed".

q: If I win the lottery, I ___ (buy) a house.
explain: If-clause "win" adalah present simple — pola Tipe 1 (kondisi realistis di masa depan) — main clause harus "will + V1": "will buy".

q: If I ___ (know) the answer, I would tell you.
explain: Main clause "would tell" menandakan Tipe 2 — if-clause harus past simple: "knew".

q: If water freezes, it ___ (expand).
explain: Fakta ilmiah tentang sifat air — Zero Conditional, kedua klausa present simple: "expands".

q: If you ___ (arrive) late again, you will be fired.
explain: Main clause "will be fired" menandakan Tipe 1 — if-clause harus present simple: "arrive".

q: If I ___ (be) a bird, I would fly to every country.
explain: Khayalan murni tidak mungkin (manusia tidak bisa jadi burung) dengan "would fly" di main clause — Tipe 2, dan "to be" hipotetis untuk "I" tetap "were".

q: Manakah kalimat yang mengandung kesalahan grammar?
opts: If it rains, we will stay home.
If it will rain, we will stay home.
If it rains, we stay home.
If it doesn't rain, we won't stay home.
explain: "If it will rain" salah karena if-clause tidak boleh memakai "will" — seharusnya "If it rains, we will stay home." Will hanya boleh ada di main clause Tipe 1.

q: Manakah kalimat yang mengandung kesalahan grammar?
opts: If I were you, I would take the job.
If I was you, I would take the job.
If she were rich, she would travel.
If it were possible, I would help.
explain: "If I was you" salah — untuk subjek hipotetis di Tipe 2, bentuk to be yang benar adalah "were" untuk semua subjek, termasuk "I": seharusnya "If I were you".

q: Manakah kalimat yang mengandung kesalahan grammar?
opts: If she studied harder, she would pass.
If she studies harder, she will pass.
If she studied harder, she will pass.
If she had studied harder, she would have passed.
explain: "If she studied harder, she will pass" mencampur if-clause Tipe 2 (past simple: studied) dengan main clause Tipe 1 (will pass) — tense-nya tidak konsisten. Seharusnya "would pass" (Tipe 2 penuh) atau ubah if-clause jadi "studies" (Tipe 1 penuh).

q: Manakah kalimat yang mengandung kesalahan grammar?
opts: If they had arrived early, they would have arrived on time.
If they had arrived early, they would arrive on time.
If they arrived early, they would arrive on time.
If they arrive early, they will arrive on time.
explain: If-clause "had arrived" adalah past perfect (ciri Tipe 3), tapi main clause "would arrive" cuma "would + V1" (ciri Tipe 2) — kurang "have". Seharusnya "would have arrived".

q: Manakah kalimat yang mengandung kesalahan grammar?
opts: If I had money, I would travel.
If I have money, I will travel.
If I would have money, I would travel.
If I had had money, I would have traveled.
explain: "If I would have money" salah karena if-clause tidak boleh memakai "would" — seharusnya "If I had money, I would travel."

q: Manakah kalimat yang mengandung kesalahan grammar?
opts: If you heat water, it boils.
If you heat water, it boil.
Water boils if you heat it.
If water is heated, it boils.
explain: Subjek "it" (orang ketiga tunggal) di present simple butuh akhiran -s: seharusnya "it boils", bukan "it boil".

q: Manakah kalimat yang mengandung kesalahan grammar?
opts: If he doesn't hurry, he will miss the bus.
If he doesn't hurry, he will misses the bus.
If he hurries, he won't miss the bus.
He will miss the bus if he doesn't hurry.
explain: Setelah modal "will", kata kerja harus bentuk dasar (V1) tanpa -s — seharusnya "will miss", bukan "will misses".

q: Manakah kalimat yang mengandung kesalahan grammar?
opts: If I had seen you, I would have said hello.
If I had seen you, I would said hello.
If I saw you, I would say hello.
If I see you, I will say hello.
explain: Main clause Tipe 3 butuh "would have + V3" — "would said" salah karena kurang "have" dan "said" (V2/V3) tidak bisa langsung menempel setelah "would". Seharusnya "would have said".

q: Ubah kalimat Tipe 1 berikut menjadi Tipe 2: "If it rains, we will cancel the trip."
opts: If it rained, we would cancel the trip.
If it rains, we would cancel the trip.
If it had rained, we would have cancelled the trip.
If it rains, we will have cancelled the trip.
explain: Transformasi Tipe 1 → Tipe 2: if-clause present simple → past simple (rains → rained), main clause will + V1 → would + V1 (will cancel → would cancel).

q: Ubah kalimat Tipe 2 berikut menjadi Tipe 3: "If I had money, I would buy a car."
opts: If I have money, I will buy a car.
If I had had money, I would have bought a car.
If I had money, I would have bought a car.
If I have had money, I would buy a car.
explain: Transformasi Tipe 2 → Tipe 3: if-clause past simple → past perfect (had → had had), main clause would + V1 → would have + V3 (would buy → would have bought).

q: Ubah kalimat Tipe 3 berikut menjadi Tipe 2: "If she had known the answer, she would have told us."
opts: If she knows the answer, she will tell us.
If she knew the answer, she would tell us.
If she had known the answer, she would tell us.
If she knew the answer, she would have told us.
explain: Transformasi Tipe 3 → Tipe 2: if-clause past perfect → past simple (had known → knew), main clause would have + V3 → would + V1 (would have told → would tell).

q: Gabungkan menjadi satu kalimat conditional Tipe 1 dengan urutan main clause duluan (tanpa koma): "If she calls, I will answer."
opts: I will answer, if she calls.
I will answer if she calls.
If she calls I will answer.
I answer if she will call.
explain: Kalau main clause ditulis duluan, tidak perlu koma: "I will answer if she calls." Koma hanya dipakai kalau if-clause ditulis lebih dulu.

q: Manakah penulisan yang benar untuk conditional dengan if-clause di awal kalimat?
opts: If it rains we will stay home.
If it rains, we will stay home.
It, if rains, we will stay home.
If, it rains we will stay home.
explain: Aturan koma: kalau if-clause ditulis duluan, wajib pakai koma sebelum main clause dimulai — "If it rains, we will stay home."

q: "We will stay home if it rains." — apakah penulisan tanpa koma ini benar?
opts: Benar, karena main clause ditulis duluan sehingga tidak perlu koma
Salah, harus tetap pakai koma di semua conditional sentence
Salah, urutan klausanya harus dibalik dulu
Benar, tapi hanya berlaku untuk Tipe 0
explain: Aturan koma cuma berlaku kalau if-clause di depan. Kalau main clause di depan seperti di sini, tidak perlu koma sama sekali — dan aturan ini berlaku untuk semua tipe, tidak khusus Tipe 0.

q: Rewrite: "If I have enough time, I visit my grandmother every weekend." — kalimat ini termasuk tipe apa, dan kenapa?
opts: Tipe 1, karena "will visit" ada di main clause
Tipe 0, karena menyatakan kebiasaan rutin dengan present simple di kedua klausa
Tipe 2, karena membicarakan sesuatu yang tidak nyata
explain: Kedua klausa pakai present simple ("have", "visit") dan menyatakan kebiasaan/rutinitas yang selalu terjadi — ini fungsi kedua dari Zero Conditional (bukan cuma fakta ilmiah, tapi juga kebiasaan tetap).

q: "If I had studied medicine, I would be a doctor now." Ini adalah contoh dari apa?
opts: Mixed conditional: syarat di masa lalu, akibat di masa kini
Mixed conditional: syarat di masa kini, akibat di masa lalu
explain: If-clause pakai past perfect (had studied — syarat yang gagal terjadi di masa lalu), tapi main clause pakai would + V1 (would be, tanpa "have") karena akibatnya dirasakan SEKARANG ("now") — pola mixed conditional: masa lalu → masa kini.

q: "If she weren't so shy, she would have asked the question yesterday." Ini adalah contoh dari apa?
opts: Mixed conditional: syarat di masa lalu, akibat di masa kini
Mixed conditional: syarat di masa kini, akibat di masa lalu
explain: If-clause pakai past simple (weren't — sifat/keadaan yang berlaku terus-menerus, sekarang pun dia masih pemalu), tapi main clause pakai would have + V3 (would have asked) karena akibatnya soal kejadian di masa lalu ("yesterday") — pola mixed conditional: masa kini → masa lalu.

q: Manakah pola bentuk yang benar untuk mixed conditional "syarat di masa lalu, akibat di masa kini"?
opts: If + past perfect, would have + V3
If + past simple, would have + V3
explain: Pola A dari mixed conditional: if-clause past perfect (menyatakan syarat yang gagal terjadi di masa lalu) + main clause would + V1 (akibat yang dirasakan sekarang, bukan "would have").

q: Manakah pola bentuk yang benar untuk mixed conditional "syarat di masa kini, akibat di masa lalu"?
opts: If + past perfect, would have + V3
If + past simple, would have + V3
If + present simple, would have + V3
explain: Pola B dari mixed conditional: if-clause past simple (menyatakan sifat/keadaan yang berlaku terus-menerus sampai sekarang) + main clause would have + V3 (akibat yang sudah terjadi/tidak terjadi di masa lalu).

q: "Unless you study, you will fail the exam." "Unless" di kalimat ini setara dengan makna apa?
explain: "Unless" berarti "if...not" — kalimat ini setara dengan "If you don't study, you will fail the exam." "Unless" sering jadi signal word Tipe 1 yang menggantikan "if not".

q: Fungsi utama dari Second Conditional (Tipe 2) di percakapan sehari-hari, selain khayalan, adalah untuk...
opts: Memberi saran/nasihat lewat pola "If I were you..."
explain: "If I were you, I would..." adalah salah satu penggunaan paling umum dari Tipe 2 dalam percakapan — dipakai untuk memberi saran, bukan cuma khayalan murni.

q: "If you press this button, the machine turns on." Kalimat ini contoh Zero Conditional untuk konteks apa?
explain: Bukan fakta ilmiah alam, tapi hasil otomatis dari sebuah instruksi/prosedur (menekan tombol selalu menyalakan mesin) — salah satu fungsi Zero Conditional selain fakta ilmiah murni.

q: Perbaiki kesalahan pada kalimat: "If I will see her, I will tell her the news."
opts: If I see her, I will tell her the news.
If I would see her, I will tell her the news.
If I saw her, I would tell her the news.
If I had seen her, I would have told her the news.
explain: Kesalahannya sama seperti pola umum Tipe 1: if-clause tidak boleh memakai "will". Karena konteksnya masih realistis/masa depan (bukan hipotetis), perbaikannya tetap Tipe 1: "If I see her, I will tell her the news."

q: Perbaiki kesalahan pada kalimat: "If I was rich, I would buy a big house."
opts: If I am rich, I will buy a big house.
If I were rich, I would buy a big house.
If I had been rich, I would have bought a big house.
If I was rich, I will buy a big house.
explain: Kesalahannya di "was" — untuk if-clause hipotetis Tipe 2, bentuk to be yang benar untuk semua subjek adalah "were": "If I were rich, I would buy a big house."

q: Manakah kalimat Tipe 3 yang paling tepat menyatakan penyesalan karena tidak membawa payung, sehingga basah kuyup?
opts: If I bring an umbrella, I don't get wet.
If I brought an umbrella, I wouldn't get wet.
If I had brought an umbrella, I wouldn't have gotten wet.
If I had brought an umbrella, I don't get wet.
explain: Kejadiannya sudah selesai (sudah basah kuyup, sudah tidak bisa diubah) — butuh Tipe 3 penuh: if-clause past perfect (had brought) + main clause would have + V3 negatif (wouldn't have gotten).

q: "If you ___ (not/hurry), you will be late for school." Lengkapi if-clause dengan bentuk yang tepat.
explain: Main clause "will be late" menandakan Tipe 1 — if-clause harus present simple negatif: "don't hurry".

q: Manakah kalimat yang secara grammar dan makna paling tepat untuk situasi: "Kenyataannya, Budi tidak lulus ujian karena dia tidak belajar minggu lalu"?
opts: If Budi studies, he passes the exam.
If Budi studied, he would pass the exam.
If Budi had studied, he would have passed the exam.
If Budi studies, he will pass the exam.
explain: Kejadian sudah terjadi di masa lalu dan sudah tidak bisa diubah (minggu lalu dia tidak belajar dan tidak lulus) — ini butuh Third Conditional penuh: "If Budi had studied, he would have passed the exam."
